headline: Italy Reports Over 60 Million Tourist Arrivals in Q3 2026
summary: Italian statistical agency ISTAT reported just over 60 million tourist arrivals and 249 million nights spent in Italian accommodation establishments during Q3 2026.
why: Tourism is a vital sector of the Italian economy, driving key services and consumer activity.

impacts.name: Italy
impacts.why: Official quarterly tourist volume data was published by ISTAT.
